summary: The study investigates the mechanical and tribological properties of melt-compounded nanocomposites of atomic-layer-deposition-coated polyamide particles and commercial nano-fillers. The focus is on the effect of ALD-coated TiO2 on the mechanical response and tribological behavior of the polyamide matrix.
evidence: The text discusses the use of atomic layer deposition (ALD) to coat polyamide particles with TiO2, and the mechanical and tribological properties of the resulting nanocomposites are compared with traditional fillers. The process parameters, including temperature and precursor usage, are detailed.
